description:
ENS resolver on Ethereum mainnet: pass name (an ASCII .eth name, e.g. vitalik.eth) to get its address, or pass address (0x + 40 hex) to get its verified primary ENS name. One paid call, USDC on Base.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/eth_ens_resolve. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__eth_ens_resolve
